resolution.note: krn pr ship fast-forwards a clean main checkout on the base after the merge; test/ci/ship.test.ts covers clean, dirty, other-branch and diverged

title: Hooks never run a main checkout older than the lane worktree they judge
body:
Observed 2026-11-17: project hooks run `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/src/dispatch/main.ts` from the main checkout. The main checkout stayed at 6f474d2 while lanes were started from origin/main after #1282 (cabbc24) added `krn.candidate/v1` to krn.json; a lane's SubagentStop then failed with exit 78 `krn.json formats: unknown format "krn.candidate/v1"` until the lead ran `git pull --ff-only` on main. `krn pr ship` merges but does not fast-forward the clean main checkout.
Outcome: after `krn pr ship` merges, a clean main checkout on the base branch is fast-forwarded to the merge commit (dirty or diverged: one warning line, no change); a regression test proves a ship leaves main at the merge SHA.
Proof: node --test on the ship test file exits 0 with a test asserting the main checkout HEAD equals the merge SHA after ship.
